steps.text: Hey ❤️ I'm home and attempting dinner before our very serious film night
Attempting doesn't sound promising
I nearly put the empty pan on and left the pasta in the cupboard
So we're having a strong start 😭
Maybe start with the water
I have water, I'm not completely lost
What's for dinner?
Pasta, tomato sauce and whatever cheese survived the week
A classic
I'm making enough for tomorrow too, so Future Me can't complain
Future You always finds something to complain about
Only when Present Me leaves her washing up 😌
How much have you created so far?
One pan, one bowl, one spoon
And a second spoon because I put the first one somewhere stupid
Impressive efficiency
You'll be laughing less when you see my masterpiece
There, actual food and not a fire in sight
That looks good
It tastes good too, I'm almost suspicious 😭
What did the second spoon contribute?
Moral support
I'll remember that next time I'm cooking
Have you eaten properly tonight?
Yeah, I've eaten and I'm settled on the sofa
Good ❤️ I'll catch up once I've put the rest away
Meal prep now? You really have changed
Don't get used to it, I'm only doing this because I'm going out tomorrow
Oh, I meant to tell you about that
With the coworker you mentioned the other night?
Yeah
My manager, actually
Your manager?
Yeah, we talked about it again today
You said coworker before
I did
I should've been clearer about who I meant
Is anybody else going?
No, just us
Right
It's just a drink after work
Where?
There's a bar a couple of streets from the office
Around seven, so I'll go straight from work
And you want to go?
Yeah, I do
I've spent most of the week going from class to work to home
I'd like to do something that isn't one of those three things
I get wanting to go out
Going out alone with your manager is a bit different from what I pictured
I know how it sounds
Especially after what you said about him looking at you differently
I probably shouldn't have made such a thing of that
You told me because it bothered you
It surprised me
But I don't feel uncomfortable around him
Does he know you're with someone?
Yes, he knows
I don't want to turn this into an argument
Me neither
I just don't want to find out I've only been hearing half the story
I know
That's why I'm telling you where we're going and who it's with
Okay
I'll text you when I get there
And when you're home?
Of course
All right
I do want to spend time with you too, you know
I know. I miss seeing you instead of just waiting for messages
I miss you too ❤️
Let me check when I finish over the next few days and we'll work something out
I'd like that
Me too
And I don't want our whole evening to disappear while I'm standing next to a pan
I'm going to change and get comfortable, then I'm yours for this awful film
I'll get it ready
A little later...
Okay, I've put the leftovers away and changed
No work clothes, no dishes in front of me, no numbers
Did you find the first spoon?
It was in the bowl the entire time
Of course it was
I'm trusting you with that information, be kind 😭
I've even claimed the good end of the sofa
That's where I'd want to be right now
There'd be room for you
You've taken up half the sofa with that blanket
I'd share the blanket, not the good cushion 😌
A generous offer
You'd take it
Yeah, I would
Soon ❤️
Are you at the beginning of the film?
Paused at the first frame
Okay, three, two, one... play
After the film...
So, about the man with the red scarf
We don't need to discuss him
He wasn't even in the second half
I was working with the information available at the time 😭
You were very confident
I trusted the scarf too much
A mistake any great detective could make
Stop laughing, at least the film was as bad as I promised
You did deliver on that
It was nicer watching it with you, though
Even with my commentary?
Especially with your commentary ❤️
I missed this, just talking about something silly with you
Me too
We should do it again, but you pick the next one
You can't blame me for your detective career ending tonight
I'm retiring undefeated, thank you 😌
That's not what happened
That's the story I'm sticking to
I'm going to bed before you talk me into watching a better one
Sleep well
You too handsome ❤️ I'm glad today was a little easier for your leg
Me too
Love you
Love you too ❤️
Good night ❤️
Good night
